record.notes: The international line is not cheaper than VN-1A: USD 59 a year against USD 18.50 a year. Every other TrumVPS line read costs more per year than VN-1A: the Vietnam long-term promotion starts at VND 700,000 a year, the Vietnam residential-IP line at VND 1,640,000 a year and the Vietnam EPYC line at VND 4,500,000 a year, against VND 480,000 a year for VN-1A. The cart's VND prices and the vendor's USD prices do not reconcile at one rate: VND 480,000 a year for VN-1A is USD 18.50, while VND 1,900,000 a year for the entry international plan is USD 59. USD 59 / 12 months = USD 4.92 per month; USD 59 x 0.70 = USD 41.30 with LOWEND30.
